heroDescription: TABVAR is a 100% volunteer-run registered non-profit. Every dollar received (outside of basic insurance and bank fees) directly purchases 316 marine-grade stainless steel bolts, anchors, chains, and drill supplies for local crags.

impactCards.title: Subsidizing New Lines
impactCards.description: Your dollars purchase heavy-duty SDS drill bits, batteries, and 316 stainless steel expansion bolts for active route developers.

impactCards.title: 50+ Year Anchor Lifespans
impactCards.description: Replacing aging, rusted plated hangers with permanent marine-grade glue-in anchors that withstand decades of freeze-thaw cycles.

retailRules.terms: Orders can be made once per month on regular-priced items. Email orders only (not available directly at retail checkout). Full instructions provided in your donation receipt.
Limited to climbing gear (harnesses, ropes, helmets, pro, carabiners, quickdraws, belay devices) and footwear (climbing shoes, approach shoes, hiking boots). One purchase per month.
Valid for in-store purchases on eligible mountain equipment. Show your donor confirmation email at checkout.
Eligible for gear and gym entry discounts. Details sent upon donation.
15% discount code valid for online purchases through the UnParallel webstore.
Released every October featuring all newly approved crags, retrofits, and topos before general public release.
